text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hi there, little veggie-poos. You must be

absolutely parched. Go on and drink u—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Your leaves are covered in bugs,
aren't
they?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't bear to see you devastated by
pests
after all our time together...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Which means I'll just have to go ahead
and clean
you up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. They're everywhere. Looks like
this is
gonna take some elbow grease...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I'd say you're all looking nice and
tidy now. I'd say this round goes to me.
I'm not to be trifled
with in a battle of
wills.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... Looks like it's not a perfect
victory,
though.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I totally forgot about training... Guess
there's
nothing to do but go apologize...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how Wonder Acute missed
training by
exterminating bugs in the
garden.
